message: I was at a friend's housewarming party the other day when the smoke alarm went off while she was making snacks. You'd think the house was on fire by the way she panicked, but it turned out she just burnt the toast. We had a good laugh, but it got me thinking about how important it is to have a plan in place, just in case. It’s nice to know I can help my friends stay calm in a crisis—anyone else have a friend who tends to overreact?
